The '''Gold Road''' runs north-south from [[Mor'shan Rampart]] to  a bridge connecting the northern and southern half of the [[Barrens]]. South of the bridge, the road was called the [[Southern Gold Road]].

==World of Warcraft==
Starting from north, you'll be at the [[Mor'shan Rampart]] and the [[Mor'shan Base Camp]]. Further south will be a road heading east towards [[Durotar]]. Then carry on going south along the road and arrive at [[Crossroads]] where you cross the East-West road ([[Ratchet]] to [[Honor's Stand]]). Carry on south and you'll pass two oasis' and [[Wailing Caverns]]. A little while later you'll come across a dried-up river which creates a "border" between North and South Barrens. Here also will be [[Beaten Corpse|Mankrik's Wife]], which is a quest target.

After going further down the road, you will find a turn-off which leads into [[Mulgore]] and before that [[Camp Taurajo]]. Further south will be a path to [[Dustwallow Marsh]]. Keep going south and there'll be a dwarven hold named [[Bael Modan]]. After that is a pass and then the [[Great Lift]] and two other instances, [[Razorfen Downs]] and [[Razorfen Kraul]].
